title: [Audit follow-up] Specify successor for legacy matrix advisory diagnostics
body:
Required sibling follow-up from #201 scope pin6093661225: https://github.com/yigini/soilfer-lims/issues/201#issuecomment-6093661225. The blocking texture-policy follow-up remains #278 and retains its separate YY scientific sign-off requirement.

At the retained main7ea12c66 contract, server/controllers/validationController.js:112–139 reparses Result.value, accepts legacy analysis aliases, infers missing units, defaults missing Na to zero, and calls legacy C:N/base diagnostics without recorded-basis checks or per-lab #201 thresholds. Existing matrix_validation.test.js:69–77 and matrix_blocking_diagnostics.test.js deliberately retain that historical API contract.

#201 keeps this path and every existing assertion unchanged under6093661225. Its authoritative evaluator reads stored numeric evidence/current reported selections only, uses policyService thresholds and strict units/bases/censoring/candidate handling, appends immutable submission evidence, and returns separate crossChecks. Legacy matrixDiagnostics never feeds those checks.

Before implementing a successor to the legacy diagnostics, pin the compatibility/retirement strategy for matrixDiagnostics consumers and the intended scientific input authority, units/bases/missing-Na handling, lab policies and test succession. Do not infer Na0, a unit, basis, conversion or analytical limit, and do not remove/disable/weaken historical tests merely to get green. Any replacement must retain strong regression evidence and add explicit before/after contracts.

Acceptance after that scope is pinned: audited source mappings for every consumer; missing-Na lower-bound or refusal semantics explicitly chosen; malformed/censored/ambiguous/missing-unit/basis fixtures; per-lab policy isolation; clear disclosure of old versus successor outputs; unchanged analytical/QC/audit rows; additive migrations and dry-run/counts if needed; complete server tests/client build/lint and Claude's exact current-head audit pass before merge/deploy.

Depends on #201 being merged. This issue grants no scientific policy value, test exception, production cleanup or deployment authority.
